selection_rule: enumerate every actually executed full-step F+B invocation before reading candidate residual values
retain every invocation in the coverage denominator
group by exact implementation pattern and semantic F+B region
deep-measure one deterministic representative per pattern unless ABI, reduction topology, or materialization differs

an item is predictor-eligible only when candidate-versus-reference residual is finite and nonzero, the complete declared parameter coordinates are reachable, and an exact-real-semantics-preserving orbit exists
zero residual is NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_RESIDUAL and not a negative prediction
no parameter reach is NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_PARAMETER_REACH and not a negative prediction
predict every eligible representative before any live-weight consequence is executed
retain both predictor-positive and predictor-negative eligible representatives

trajectory_protocol.consequence_null: five fixed seeds; a new non-default exact reduction orbit at every step
report: joint drift Gram and participation-ratio effective rank
